articles.t: GTA 6 Leaker Releases Xbox Game File, Raising Fears Of Unofficial PC Version – channelnews
articles.txt:
A group responsible for leaking Grand Theft Auto 6 footage and game assets has reportedly released an executable file from an incomplete Xbox build of the highly anticipated game, raising concerns that an unofficial PC version could soon emerge.
The group, known as Cyberleek, previously threatened to release additional gameplay footage unless Rockstar Games reversed its controversial digital-only launch strategy.
The threats came shortly before Rockstar released an extended GTA 6 gameplay teaser on Netflix.
Cyberleek subsequently warned that it could publish a complete build of the game, including the entire story mode and end credits.
According to IGN, the group has now released an executable file associated with the leaked Xbox version, prompting speculation that AI-assisted recompilation techniques could allow developers to get the game running on PC within days.
However, there is no confirmation that such a conversion is technically feasible or that a working unofficial PC version is imminent.
In a statement accompanying the latest release, Cyberleek claimed its activities were motivated by opposition to what it described as anti-consumer practices within the gaming industry.
The group also acknowledged ongoing attempts by Rockstar’s parent company, Take-Two Interactive, to identify those responsible for the leaks and prevent further distribution of confidential material.
“Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving,” the group said.
Cyberleek also rejected allegations that its activities were primarily designed to promote a cryptocurrency scheme.
It claimed cryptocurrency donations were being used to finance a separate undisclosed project, arguing that anonymous financial transactions were necessary to protect those involved.
“There is no other way to move funds without names,” the group claimed.
Take-Two has previously issued subpoenas targeting companies including Discord, Microsoft and X as part of its investigation into the GTA 6 leaks.
According to IGN, the existence of the leaked Xbox executable also raises questions about earlier suggestions that Cyberleek only possessed an early development version of the game.
It remains unclear how the files were obtained, how complete the leaked build is, or whether the latest release will result in a playable unofficial PC version.
Rockstar has yet to publicly explain the circumstances surrounding the latest reported leak.

articles.t: The 6 Most Outrageous GTA 6 Myths, Debunked
articles.chapeau: The internet is already drowning in GTA 6 misinformation
articles.txt:
After a wild opening weekend, Grand Theft Auto 6 is off to the races. Millions are playing Rockstar’s enormous open-world game and discovering its complexities in real time. There’s a lot to unpack in a game that’s filled with intersecting gameplay systems across a long story, and some players are already taking advantage of that. At the same time, the opening days of GTA 6 ’s launch have been filled with misinformation, much of it fueled by culture warriors and content creators looking to turn outrage into clicks on social media platforms that incentivize such behavior.
Because of that, there are a lot of myths about GTA 6 currently floating around the internet. Some come from harmless misunderstandings, while others are more deliberate misrepresentations intended to scare off potential players. To help you navigate the noise, we’ve rounded up some of the most rampant myths currently circulating around GTA 6 and fact-checked them accordingly.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon The claim: GTA 6 ’s story forces you to do chores for Lucia instead of crimes.
If you spent launch day watching reactions to GTA 6 ’s early hours roll in instead of playing, you might have walked away thinking that Rockstar made a chore simulator. That’s thanks to a few early missions that revolve around Jason getting his home ready for Lucia as she’s about to be released from prison. Players will paint a bedroom for her, fix a leaky roof, and repair some stairs. There’s also an optional quest where players can run errands to prepare for Lucia's arrival , like picking up groceries or buying her a necklace. All of this happens in the first few hours of the game. GTA 6 quickly ramps up after that, getting into the series’ usual flow of cop chases, heists, and shootouts. You can call it a slow start, but know that any mundane missions you’ve seen make up a very small amount of story that you’re likely to see in your very first play session.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon The claim: GTA 6 doesn’t allow you to steal cars, or heavily restricts what you can steal.
While there’s a grain of truth to this, it has been heavily exaggerated on social media. There are some select cars that you can’t steal in GTA 6 , like those around Jason’s neighborhood or in an NPC’s car lot. But for the most part, you can jack just about any vehicle you see in Leonida. The catch is that you’ll need a device that can copy keys to get into some of the more expensive cars, and you won’t get that until Chapter 3. Being able to steal anything requires some patience as you play through the story, but be rest assured that you can do as much grand theft auto as ever in Grand Theft Auto.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon The claim: Airplanes will bounce off of buildings instead of exploding on impact.
This one is a little tricky to unpack because there seem to be two weird things colliding here. After videos of airplanes bouncing off of skyscrapers like rubber began to emerge on social media , players deduced that content creators were sharing videos where they had their Reduced Vehicle Damage setting turned on. It seemed like a textbook case of outrage farming, though there may be a slight bit of truth here. Some players have speculated that GTA 6 may have a few physics bugs that make it tough for certain airliners to blow up as expected. That may be an edge case, but I can confirm that I have crashed plenty of planes into buildings in GTA 6 , and they have all exploded into a fiery wreck so far.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon The claim: GTA 6 features no autosave, and you will lose progress if you don’t manually save.
When players started reporting that they were losing hours of gameplay because GTA 6 didn’t have an autosave feature, I was very confused. I can open my save file right now and see a dedicated auto save slot that is regularly refreshed as I play. I initially wrote it off as players either lying or not realizing that the auto save only triggers after completing major missions, but it turns out they weren’t hallucinating. GTA 6 ’s first patch fixed an issue where auto save wasn’t triggering properly. So, yes, GTA 6 does have autosave; it just wasn’t working correctly for some players at launch. It shouldn’t be a problem now, but always remember to save early and often just in case.

articles.t: GTA 6 : une version PC non officielle déjà en préparation grâce à la build Xbox volée
articles.txt:
Quelques heures seulement après la diffusion de la build Xbox complète de GTA 6 par le groupe de hackers Cyberleek , la communauté des moddeurs a déjà réussi à créer une première version PC non officielle du jeu. Cette conversion, encore très limitée, permet d’accéder aux écrans de démarrage, aux réglages et aux informations légales, mais pas encore au gameplay. Cependant, les progrès pourraient s’accélérer dans les semaines à venir, grâce notamment à l’utilisation d’outils d’intelligence artificielle.
La build Xbox de GTA 6 a fuité il y a quelques heures à peine, et déjà, des moddeurs ont réussi à la faire fonctionner sur PC. Cette première version, qualifiée de « teaser » par la communauté, ne permet pas encore d’explorer le monde ouvert de Vice City, mais elle prouve que la conversion est techniquement possible. Les moddeurs ont utilisé des outils d’IA comme Claude pour analyser le code de la version Xbox et l’adapter à l’architecture PC. Une prouesse qui aurait été impensable il y a encore quelques années.
Pour l’instant, les joueurs curieux ne peuvent que naviguer dans les menus de configuration, choisir les commandes et consulter les mentions légales. Aucun élément de gameplay n’est accessible, mais les spécialistes estiment que cela pourrait changer rapidement. Les projets de reverse engineering de ce type ont déjà démontré leur capacité à évoluer vite, surtout lorsqu’ils s’appuient sur des modèles d’IA performants.
Le principe de ces conversions repose sur l’analyse du code original de la version console, ici la build Xbox, pour le rendre compatible avec les PC. L’intelligence artificielle joue un rôle clé dans ce processus : elle permet de comprendre le fonctionnement du code et de le réécrire pour une autre plateforme. Cette méthode, encore expérimentale, pourrait réduire considérablement le temps nécessaire pour obtenir une version jouable.
Les moddeurs à l’origine de ce projet n’ont pas encore communiqué de calendrier précis. La complexité technique de GTA 6 , avec ses nombreux systèmes de jeu et son monde ouvert très détaillé, rend difficile toute prédiction. Néanmoins, l’enthousiasme de la communauté est palpable, et certains espèrent voir des séquences de gameplay dans les prochaines semaines.
Cette fuite et la conversion PC qui en découle représentent un sérieux problème pour Rockstar Games . Le studio, connu pour son obsession de la sécurité, a déjà été victime de plusieurs violations majeures, dont le fameux leak de 2022 qui avait dévoilé des images du jeu en développement. Mais cette fois, la situation est différente : la build Xbox complète est entre les mains de la communauté, et une version PC non officielle pourrait voir le jour avant la sortie officielle du jeu sur cette plateforme.
Rockstar Games n’a pas encore officiellement annoncé de version PC pour GTA 6 , qui doit sortir en 2025 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Si une conversion non officielle devenait jouable, cela pourrait pousser le studio à accélérer ses plans, voire à revoir sa stratégie de sortie. Pour l’instant, Rockstar se concentre sur des actions légales contre les responsables de la fuite, mais la diffusion massive de la build rend la situation difficile à contrôler.
Pour les joueurs PC, cette nouvelle est à double tranchant. D’un côté, elle laisse entrevoir la possibilité de découvrir GTA 6 plus tôt que prévu, même si cela se ferait via une version non officielle et potentiellement instable. De l’autre, elle soulève des questions éthiques et légales : utiliser une build volée est illégal et expose à des risques de sécurité. De plus, une telle version ne bénéficierait d’aucun support officiel et pourrait être truffée de bugs.
Il est important de rappeler que le téléchargement et l’utilisation de cette build sont interdits et peuvent entraîner des poursuites. Rockstar Games a déjà engagé des actions en justice contre les personnes impliquées dans la fuite, et les autorités pourraient également sévir contre les utilisateurs. Les joueurs sont donc invités à la prudence et à attendre une éventuelle annonce officielle concernant la version PC de GTA 6 .
En attendant, la communauté des moddeurs continue de travailler sur cette conversion, et il faudra suivre de près l’évolution de ce projet dans les prochaines semaines. Une chose est sûre : GTA 6 n’a pas fini de faire parler de lui.

articles.t: 10 Hidden Controls Every
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 has a bunch of hidden controls that unlock fun features. You can avoid the cops, kick NPCs on your motorcycle, and tap into a secret first-person mode.
articles.txt:
You can have a ton of fun in GTA 6 even if you only follow the core gameplay loop of running around, stealing cars, and completing missions and side quests. However, if you take a minute to learn a few hidden controls, I think you'll enjoy the game even more. These are fairly simple controls that let you hide from the cops, trash talk other drivers, or flip the bird when you're feeling like annoying NPCs. These are 10 of the best hidden GTA 6 controls that'll help you unlock an entirely new side of the game.
If you just want to sit back and relax as your character drives around Leonida in GTA 6 , you should try the auto-drive mode. It's a relaxing way to enjoy the streets without having to worry about following traffic rules. To enable it, you need to get in a vehicle and add a waypoint on the map. This serves as your character's destination, so if you want a longer drive, be sure to drop the waypoint far, far away. Next, hold the down arrow on the D-Pad, and press the Option button. This enables cinematic mode. Then, hold the Circle button to enable auto-drive.
Your character is going to commit a lot of crimes in GTA 6. When this happens, you attract heat, and soon enough, cops will begin chasing you. Switching cars is a great way to reduce the amount of attention you get from law enforcement, but you can still be identified by your face or clothing. Until you can reach a safe spot to swap outfits, maintain a low profile by ducking while driving. Hold the Circle button while driving to duck.
EA's Road Rash was among the first racing games I played as a child, and I remember how much fun it was to kick your rivals while speeding through the game's various courses. You can have a taste of that in GTA 6 too. Press the Square button while you're riding a bike, and your character will kick anyone who's near you. If you do this in a car, it opens the door, and hits people around the car. To annoy other drivers, press R3 , and your character will direct some trash talk towards NPCs.
Hold Circle to lean back against walls, or to sit on the beach. To rest on a ledge, you can hold L3 . This lets you take a moment to soak in beautiful views in the game, or lounge around as you listen to NPC conversations. Paying attention to those conversations can lead to some fun side quests, and sometimes give you a tip or two for quick money or other rewards.
If you really want to rile people up in GTA 6 , you can flip the bird. This works only when your character is unarmed. Hold L2 , focus on a person, then press R1 . Actions have consequences in GTA 6 , so be prepared to fight NPCs when you do this.
When you're being chased by cops, enemies, or angry NPCs, you can use a quick shortcut to look back without turning the camera around. Just hold R3 to look behind you.
While driving, press Circle to toggle headlights (and switch to high beams). This is particularly useful when you're offroading at night. You can also hold left arrow on the D-Pad, and move the right stick up to access other vehicle controls like hazard lights, opening or closing windows, etc., in case you want to add to the realism.
Stealing emergency vehicles in GTA 6 is risky, but the reward is totally worth it. Not only do you find stashes of weapons, gear, and money in some of these vehicles, but you also have access to sirens that help you clear traffic off your path. If you steal an ambulance or a cop car, hold L3 , and move the left stick up to go through different siren tones. Press L3 and the left stick up to enable the siren.
GTA 6 is a third-person game, but it has a first-person mode that partially works. It is useful for looking at smaller objects around your character, such as posters, small signs, or to look for clues in and around a house. (Yes, I am talking about Mandy's creepy house and bad vibes.) Hold L2 + hit R3 to switch to first-person mode. Sadly, you can't move when you do this, but you can look around. Try it in Mandy's property to observe a few nasty surprises.
When you sprint towards a car, press the X button to slide across the hood. This is much faster and smoother than running around parked cars or jumping over them. It also looks cool, which is reason enough to try this feature.

articles.t: Do GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption Take Place in the Same Universe? The Fan Theory Explained.
articles.chapeau: A mysterious book hidden in GTA 6 has reignited a longtime fan theory that Rockstar's two biggest franchises share a timeline.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google It’s probably not a surprise to learn that players can find Red Dead Redemption -related Easter eggs in GTA 6 , considering both franchises are put out by Rockstar. Players have found a chihuahua – which, like other animals in the game, is able to be petted – who has what appears to be an Arthur Morgan doll on its back, complete with saddle. But could it go deeper than that?
It’s definitely possible that Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption take place in the same timeline, just a century or so apart. For one thing, Arthur and the chihuahua aren’t the only Red Dead -related Easter eggs in the game. One eagle-eyed player noticed a license plate on the back of a car, which features “New Austin” across the top – a city that features in Red Dead Redemption, its sequel , and the multiplayer game Red Dead Online.
Players in GTA 6 can also track down a hat that bears a strong resemblance to the one Arthur Morgan wears. Discoverable in Chapter 2, players can find Arthur’s hat by driving to a house in Kelly County, where someone is hosting a yard sale. There, as long as they have $35 on hand, the character – either Jason or Lucia – can buy and wear Arthur’s hat.
According to X user @GameRoll , though, there could be more to it than a few entertaining Easter eggs. GameRoll found a book in Brian’s marina hideout that not only makes further references to Red Dead locations, like New Austin, Armadillo, and Blackwater – it also mentions a scene directly from Red Dead Redemption 2.
In RDR2, the player can take on a side quest as Arthur, where he is tasked with taking out Flaco Hernández near the shores of Cairn Lake, where Hernandez is hiding out. When Arthur finds Flaco, the player has to fight their way through Flaco’s crew before reaching the man himself. Eventually, whether through a playable fight or successfully completing a shooting minigame, Arthur is able to defeat him.
The book – with its memorable title, The Cowboy’s Prayer is to Die Young – that the player can find at the marina details its main character, Rusty, finds the body of the outlaw he had been tracking already dead in the snow. The outlaw is named as Flaco, and in the book, is said to have a bullet hole right in the middle of his forehead. And that is exactly how Arthur takes out Flaco in Red Dead Redemption 2.
Because the book is billed within the game as a fictional novel, this could mean one of two things – either Red Dead Redemption and its characters are part of the cultural zeitgeist as fictional characters, or the book is based on real events which took place earlier in the joint timeline. Nothing has been confirmed by Rockstar yet, though.
So whether or not the book serves as a hint that Red Dead Redemption and Grand Theft Auto have a deeper connection, it’s a great find and another indication of just how deeply the world of GTA 6 has been brought to life.

Ajouter The Media Leader à vos sources préférées Copier le lien Partager LinkedIn Facebook sur X Threads par mail Lire plus tard Les revenus issus des achats intégrés dans les jeux mobiles ont chuté de 36,6% en France dans les deux jours suivant la sortie de GTA VI, par rapport à la moyenne des deux périodes équivalentes précédentes, selon AppsFlyer. La France enregistre ainsi la plus forte baisse parmi les huit marchés étudiés. Le nombre de sessions n’a pourtant reculé que de 3,7%, et les installations de 4,8% : les joueurs ont continué à jouer, mais ont moins dépensé.
Contrairement à ce que l’on aurait pu anticiper, la sortie de GTA VI ne s’est pas accompagnée d’une hausse de l’activité sur les applications de livraison de repas, dont les installations ont reculé de 8,9%. Dans la catégorie Action & Strategy, la plus proche du jeu sur mobile, les installations ont diminué de 11,7%.
« Avec un prix compris entre 80 et 100 dollars pour GTA VI, il est raisonnable de penser que certains joueurs y ont consacré une partie du budget qu’ils auraient autrement dépensé dans les jeux mobiles », explique Adam Smart, director of product for gaming chez AppsFlyer. Mais selon lui, le recul plus marqué de la catégorie Casino suggère que d’autres facteurs sont à l’œuvre : « GTA VI contribue peut-être à cette évolution, mais il est peu probable qu’il en soit la seule cause ».

articles.t: GTA 6 is already playable in your browser, but only if you're extremely patient
articles.chapeau: Who needs a PC port when you've got online friends? 🤷‍♂️
articles.txt:
GTA 6 is playable on PC, after all - just not in the way Rockstar Games intended.
Even after all the safeguards and console updates, Grand Theft Auto VI is still playable on PC months (or years) before an official port.
GTA VI l aunched last week exclusively for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. It's without a doubt one of the best games ever made.
But, as per usual, PC players are having to wait their turn as Rockstar Games always releases the console version first and the PC version later .
It’s understandable. Console players make up the majority of Grand Theft Auto players, but in 2026, we’d have really expected a multi-platform launch.
Worry not though PC owners. You can in fact play GTA VI on your rig, but you will have to get in line…
Over on X, a user by the name of germanfndezz has done something incredible. They’ve made their PlayStation 5 console playable in a web browser: “My PS5 does nothing most of the day, so I put it online. You get in line and when it's your turn you have the controller.”
It’s completely free, and while its popularity has unfortunately led to a temporary takedown at the time of writing, it’s expected to be back up and running soon.
The only catch is you need to queue for a go on the console, and the queue can get really, really long.
It’s also not considered piracy like other free web browser ports. You don’t need a ROM of GTA VI to play, and the copy being played on the console was purchased legally. This is basically the digital equivalent of passing your friend the PlayStation 5 controller when they’re at your house.
The experience isn’t seamless, of course. Because you’re essentially streaming someone’s console footage to your device, you can expect some input delay and stuttering issues, but it’s a hilarious and oddly wholesome way to play the game.
As we said before though, the popularity of the project has unfortunately taken it offline for a while, and germanfndezz has warned that he’ll never ask for money or funding to bring it back, so beware of impersonators. They’ve encouraged players to join their Discord though for updates on the project.
It's possible that other PlayStation 5 owners will see this and get inspired to do the same. Now we’ll be honest and say we don’t know how one would set something like this up, but it’s still really cool.
It’s probably also the only way you’ll play the game on PC for quite a while… Rockstar Games has made no mention of the PC port just yet, but dataminers and leaks believe it’ll release early next year.
Whether the next iteration of GTA Online drops at the same time, or later in 2027, remains to be seen.

articles.t: Is There a Casino in GTA 6? Gambling Explained
articles.chapeau: Is there a casino in GTA 6? Find out where to locate both casinos in Vice City, whether you can gamble, and if GTA Online could add gambling.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google In Grand Theft Auto VI , there are two casinos that players can visit on the Leonida map. However, can you actually gamble? Here is everything you need to know about the casinos in GTA 6, where to find them, and what you can do inside.
Yes, there are two casinos in GTA 6 . However, both businesses are currently inaccessible in the main Grand Theft Auto VI story, so you cannot gamble. Even after completing all five chapters, the casinos will remain locked, with no way to enter either building.
While this is disappointing, players can still visit both casino locations while exploring Vice City. Interestingly, one of the buildings even has a sign outside suggesting that it could eventually open in the future.
There are two casinos that players can find on the Leonida Map . Both buildings are located in Vice City and can be visited fairly early in the game after reaching GTA 6 Chapter 3 . However, neither location has a playable interior.
The Vice City Casino is located in southern Leonard County, just east of Bellville and south of Waning Sands . You can find the large casino building near the highway interchange across the water from Leaf Links.
This is arguably the most recognizable casino in Grand Theft Auto VI , as the building has a massive sign displaying its name. Unfortunately, despite looking like a fully operational business from the outside, you cannot enter it.
Even if you return to the Vice City Casino after completing Chapter 5, the doors will remain locked. There are also no story missions that unlock the location.
The Merlin’s Palace Casino is located in southern Balsero in Vice-Dale County , just west of Lowballer Customs . The building can be found near NW 15th Avenue and has a medieval-themed design.
Interestingly, if you visit Merlin’s Palace Casino, you will discover a sign outside stating that the business is temporarily closed for restoration.
This has led some players to speculate that Rockstar Games could eventually open the casino in a future update. However, despite the sign, there is currently no way to enter Merlin’s Palace or access any gambling activities inside.
No, you cannot gamble in GTA 6’s Story Mode. Unlike previous games in the series, there are no playable casino games such as poker, blackjack, roulette, or slot machines.
Rockstar Games actually addressed the lack of gambling in an interview with Kotaku. According to the studio’s Vice President of Design, Stephen Donkin, gambling didn’t fit Jason and Lucia’s story or the balance the developers wanted for the game’s economy.
However, this doesn’t necessarily mean that gambling will never be added to GTA 6 . Rockstar has also explained that the Leonida map was designed with long-term possibilities in mind, leaving certain locations available for future content.
It’s currently unclear whether Rockstar Games will eventually add gambling to GTA 6 through a future update or save the feature for GTA 6 Online.
However, there is a precedent for this happening. When Grand Theft Auto V originally launched in 2013, the Vinewood Casino was inaccessible. It wasn’t until July 2019 that Rockstar finally opened the building as part of the Diamond Casino & Resort update for GTA Online.
The update allowed players to gamble using casino chips, play blackjack and roulette, and even spin a Lucky Wheel to win vehicles and other rewards. Given that GTA 6 already has two casino buildings on its map, it’s possible that Rockstar could take a similar approach with its upcoming multiplayer mode. However, nothing has been officially confirmed yet.
For now, both the Vice City Casino and Merlin’s Palace Casino remain closed, and players will have to wait to see whether Rockstar eventually introduces gambling to Grand Theft Auto VI .

articles.t: 6 Signs GTA 6 Is Ruining Your Relationship, According to a Couples Therapist
articles.chapeau: A couples therapist explains how your GTA 6 obsession could be hurting your relationship and when to put the controller down.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google GTA 6 came out last week, and many people haven’t been seen since.
The game finally launched November 19, bringing in an estimated $1.84 billion by release day, according to Sensor Tower figures reported by Fox 5 DC . Couples therapist Duygu Balan wrote in Psychology Today that some of her clients had discussed taking time off work or booking hotel rooms just to play uninterrupted. She understands the temptation. As she put it, “reality hasn’t been doing a great job of selling itself lately.”
A guy on Reddit says his girlfriend is upset that his GTA 6 character has a girlfriend. She doesn’t want him pursuing a fictional relationship with Lucia, one of the game’s main characters. He’s 18 and already arguing about infidelity that hasn’t happened in real life.
Couples were arguing about video games long before anyone set foot in Leonida, though. In a 2012 study involving 349 couples, researchers at Brigham Young University found that 75% of gamers’ spouses wished their partner put more time and energy into the marriage. Researcher Neil Lundberg pointed out that the arguments gaming caused were a bigger issue than the number of hours spent playing.
So, when does a harmless obsession with GTA 6 start interfering with your actual relationship?
Taking a few days off to play a game you’ve waited 13 years for sounds wonderful. But booking yourself a hotel room while your partner handles Thanksgiving dinner and takes care of the kids without so much as a conversation beforehand? Good luck selling that idea. Balan points out that time away from shared responsibilities affects both people, especially when only one of them gets a vacation.
Your partner asks a question halfway through a mission, and you snap at them for interrupting. It happens again the next night. After a while, they might stop trying to get your attention at all.
In Gottman Institute research , couples who stayed married responded to each other’s small attempts at connection 86% of the time. Among those who later divorced, that figure was just 33%.
GTA 6 lets you build Jason and Lucia’s relationship by buying flowers and spending time together, eventually working your way up to a rating called “Hot Together.”
But seriously, when was the last time you did anything remotely close to that for your actual partner? If you’re putting hours into keeping a fictional girlfriend happy but can’t remember the last time you planned a date, you might want to reconsider where all that romantic effort is going.
Your partner shouldn’t have to remind you to eat dinner because you’ve been gaming for eight hours. Or keep asking you to take care of something around the house while you promise you’ll get to it after one more mission. Balan warns that this can turn a relationship into an uncomfortable parent-child arrangement, with one person handling the responsibilities and the other getting irritated whenever they’re asked to contribute.
There’s always another mission to finish in Leonida, and it’s a hell of a lot easier than dealing with that argument about money you had yesterday. Everyone needs an escape once in a while. But if you’re counting down the minutes until your partner goes to bed so you can spend the rest of the night gaming, what are you trying so hard to avoid?
In GTA 6, you know what you’re supposed to accomplish, and the game rewards you when you do it. Real life doesn’t always offer that satisfaction. You’re not getting an achievement badge for paying your electric bill.
Balan suggests thinking about why spending time in Leonida has become so much more appealing than spending time at home. Especially if the game is starting to replace things you used to enjoy doing with your partner.
The BYU study also found that couples who played together generally enjoyed the experience more. So handing your partner a controller could be a start, assuming they’re interested. Otherwise, agree on some uninterrupted gaming time that doesn’t leave them handling everything else.
You waited 13 years for GTA 6. Your partner probably doesn’t want to wait that long to see you again.

articles.t: GTA 6's Jason Actor Had A Small Role On Modern Family - TVLine
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 Jason voice actor Dylan Rourke appeared on Modern Family in Season 8's Snow Ball episode, playing a student credited as Big Guy during a school dance.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games Add TVLine on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover After 13 years, the wait for "Grand Theft Auto VI" is finally over, and some people are recognizing one of its lead actors from "Modern Family," one of the most beloved family sitcoms of all time . Dylan Rourke, who voices Jason, had a brief but memorable appearance on the long-running sitcom.
Rourke's "Modern Family" moment comes midway through Season 8 in an episode titled "Snow Ball." The episode revolves around Manny (Rico Rodriguez) and Luke (Nolan Gould) attempting to put on the school's winter dance and, as always, hilarity ensues. Rourke plays one of the students attending the dance, credited as "Big Guy," and appears in two scenes. In the first, he's picked on by a school bully, and in the second, he interrupts Manny's big speech by asking, "Who are you?"
It was a small appearance, but a far cry from Rourke's considerably larger role as Jason in "Grand Theft Auto VI."
ABC Humor has long been part of the "Grand Theft Auto" franchise, and Dylan Rourke has plenty of comedic experience himself. He has a background in sketch comedy, having trained with The Groundlings, Second City, and Upright Citizens Brigade. He even appeared on stage with legendary comedian Fred Willard in Willard's sketch comedy show.
When it comes to television, his résumé includes multiple appearances in popular shows aside from "Modern Family." He's made several appearances in the Shonda-verse, including three episodes of "Station 19" and one episode of "Grey's Anatomy," which is considered one of the best ABC shows of all time . His longest-running television role to date was a seven-episode stint on "In the Vault," a murder mystery series where he appeared alongside Sydney Sweeney.
Since his casting in "Grand Theft Auto VI" was revealed, Rourke has said little publicly about the experience. However, on the day of the game's release, he shared a joint Instagram statement with Manni L. Perez, who voices the female protagonist, Lucia . "We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower," the pair wrote. The role marks Rourke's biggest project to date.

articles.t: The missing piece needed to get the leaked GTA 6 Xbox build running on PC has reportedly surfaced online
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek has reportedly released the missing executable from the leaked GTA 6 Xbox build, but getting it to run on PC still requires substantial work.
articles.txt:
Cyberleek has reportedly released the missing executable from a leaked GTA 6 Xbox build, giving modders another file to examine. It cannot simply run on Windows: recompilation, reverse-engineering, and other technical hurdles remain. The release does not mean GTA 6 is playable on PC.
As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases. TweakTown may also earn commissions from Best Buy and other affiliate partners at no extra cost to you.
Just a day after reports surfaced that Cyberleek had leaked a near-complete Xbox build of GTA 6, the missing piece may have finally arrived. The leaker, who previously claimed that modders could get the game running on PC within a week , has reportedly released the main executable from the Xbox version.
The original leak included almost all of the game's Xbox assets and files, but was missing the main executable needed to launch it. Cyberleek had promised to release that file on Monday, November 23, or sooner if its cryptocurrency reached a $15 million market cap. The latest claims suggest the executable is now circulating online.
The post that brought the development to wider attention came from Chasm on X, who said the .exe was available but stressed that it cannot simply be copied onto a Windows PC and launched. Modders will still need to work through recompilation and other reverse-engineering challenges before the Xbox build can run outside its original environment.
Chasm also offered a rough estimate of how long that work could take. According to the post, those with the right skills could potentially get into the game within one to three days, while achieving higher frame rates on high-end GPUs could take two to four weeks.
The executable's release also gives the community another piece to examine when assessing the original leak. Cyberleek has provided SHA-256 checksums for the file, allowing others to compare it against the version being circulated. However, matching checksums alone cannot establish that the entire Xbox build is authentic or complete.
2 The page lists download mirrors for what is reportedly the missing GTA 6 Xbox executable, which still can’t run directly on a Windows PC. VIEW GALLERY - 2 IMAGES There's still considerable work ahead. The reported build uses Microsoft's GDK architecture, which shares much of its foundation with Windows and could make adapting it easier than porting a game built exclusively around console hardware. Even so, modders will need to deal with missing system files, anti-tamper measures, and other technical hurdles before the game can run reliably on PC.

Un contenu qui n’a pas plu aux modérateurs de Sony.

PlayStation indique attendre « de tous les joueurs qu’ils agissent avec décence, respect et considération les uns envers les autres » et enjoint le joueur, toujours selon ce message, à « consulter le code de conduite », lequel prohibe le « contenu obscène, pornographique ou illégal ».

articles.t: Goodbye, Mandy: GTA 6 Players Are Already Obsessed With Someone Else
articles.chapeau: Meet Vicki, Lucia’s new buddy
articles.txt:
As Grand Theft Auto 6 began releasing around the world last week, players quickly became obsessed with Mandy . She's a neighbor of Jason's who tries to seduce the himbo while he fixes her sink. (And she is totally not a serial killer , no way, why would you ask?) Mandy shows up early in GTA 6 . But as more players advance in the game, they're becoming obsessed with a new character: Vicki, a standout character from Chapter 2.
[ Ed. note: Light spoilers for the end of Chapter 1 and beginning of Chapter 2 follow. We'll keep them vague.]
After Jason is injured at the end of Chapter 1, Lucia takes him to a run-down motel to lie low. She wants to find stronger painkillers for him, which leads her to Vicki. She's a goth exotic dancer who also moonlights as a small-time drug dealer, and immediately pulls one over on Lucia by selling her over-the-counter Zombix (GTA's brand of painkiller) for $50. Lucia then barges back into Vicki's room and demands the drugs she paid for, which takes the two on a trip around Port Gellhorn. They get Vicki's paycheck from Delights Cabaret and save her friend Dunk from a gang, all the while getting to know one another. They bond over the fact that they're both moms trying to support their kids by whatever means necessary.
Players have quickly fallen for Vicki. "Love her she's my favorite character so far," one player wrote on Reddit.
"Punk Ana de Armas," another said , and, you know, I can kinda see it.
Vicki is voiced by Taryn Manning, who's best known for her role in Orange Is the New Black . She's also starred in 8 Mile , Hustle and Flow , and Hawaii Five-0 .
Manning's work as Vicki is part of the reason why players are flocking to her. "Mandy didn't do it for me, but Vicki did because I recognized Taryn Manning’s voice immediately," one Redditor said .
"Vicki the baddie that made everyone move on from Mandy lmao," another said .
Basically, you can tell how far thirsty GTA 6 players are getting in the game based on who they're obsessively posting about over on the Grand Theft Auto subreddits. In a few days, as players continue to marathon Rockstar's hit , I'm sure they'll have a new favorite.

articles.chapeau: CyberLeek posted a 57MB archive it says completes a stolen Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto 6, and the Leonida recompilation project is testing the files for a PC port. articles.txt:
Save Advertisements CyberLeek posted a 57MB archive it says completes a stolen Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto 6, and the Leonida recompilation project is testing the files for a PC port. Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive have not commented, while rumors point to an official PC release next year.
CyberLeek, a hacking gang, released a 57MB archive Monday that it says completes a stolen Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto 6 and could help modders port the game to PC.
The group updated its website with a link to the archive. "The exe is out. Always free. An early Christmas gift from CL," CyberLeek wrote in a post titled "Xmas came early." The archive completes the stolen Xbox build that CyberLeek began circulating last week through a 209GB torrent containing files for Rockstar's RAGE game engine and the Xbox console.
CyberLeek says the file dump will let the modding community recompile the game for PC, because the Xbox platform runs on an operating system based on Microsoft Windows. "The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects," the gang wrote. The group asks for donations to its meme coin after earlier efforts to push that coin's market cap failed.
One recompilation project, Leonida, has examined the leaked executable files. Traffic overloaded the group's Discord chat server, which malfunctioned and appeared to crash. An admin posted after the outage: "It will take at least a week for us to get somewhere noticeable to the point where you can play on your pc." The admin added: "We will not be giving assets whatsoever; you will need to download the game yourself." Before the leak dropped, an admin posted: "This .exe file does NOT RUN THE GAME. This will be used by the developers to work with and make the actual recomp, which will use the game files and exe to build the port."
Users in the project have used AI coding tools and agents, including Anthropic's Claude, to reverse-engineer the leaked files and try to run them on Windows. One user in the Discord chat claimed: "THE GAME ALMOST BOOTS. BLACK SCREEN, AUDIO CUTS OFF."
Rockstar Games and its parent, Take-Two Interactive, have not responded to a request for comment. Rumors point to an official PC release for GTA 6 as soon as the first quarter of next year. A pirated PC port could go viral and sap sales for a game that remains exclusive to the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
The dumped files suggest CyberLeek infiltrated and stole an Xbox copy of GTA 6 before the game launched. Take-Two subpoenaed major platforms, including Microsoft, for records in an effort to find the leaker. CyberLeek remains at large.
Source : GTA 6 Leaker Releases All Files for Alleged Xbox Build of Game , by Michael Kan , PCMAG , Nov 23, 2026

articles.chapeau: Trying to make money at the beginning of Chapter 2 in GTA 6? Here's how to fill your account fast and recover your lost cash.
articles.txt:
Without spoiling anything, the beginning of GTA 6's second chapter is something of a soft reset. You'll arrive in a seedy motel in the middle of nowhere, with no cash, car or resources. And to make matters worse, you have an aggressive manager demanding rent upfront, as well as countless other financial woes to deal with.
Although there are ways to mitigate losing all your Chapter 1 savings ( you can read about them here! ), you'll still need to make some stacks as quickly as possible. Luckily, there are far more ways to make that cash than before. To help you out, here's how to make money fast in Chapter 2 of GTA 6 , so you can get back on your feet.
Although you might already have figured out some sneaky tricks for making money, Chapter 2's Girls Trip mission will introduce several opportunities to bank cash through less-than-legal means. We've covered all of them below, along with details on how to most effectively utilise them. We've also detailed an optional opportunity you could chase up to recover a big wad of cash, albeit with a lot of risk involved.
To skip ahead to a specific money-making scheme, use the links below:
If you're looking for any of these to focus on fully, Stick Ups are the quickest way we found to make cash fast , as long as you can keep your Wanted level low and visit multiple shops in one run.
From the Girls Trip mission onwards, you'll now be able to stick up stores and make a ton of money doing it. Open up the map, then press [ps5: RIGHT] to pull up the Robberies tab . Scroll to " Stick Ups ", and you'll be able to see every robbable store on the map.
To do these in the most efficient way possible, make sure to stash a car somewhere near the back of the store , and wear a mask, hat and glasses . Now, head inside and aim your gun at the cashier to instigate the robbery. Sometimes the cashier will set off an alarm, but most of the time the cashier, other employees, and customers will just hold up their hands and wait for you to make your demands.
Grab the cash from the register, then head into the back of the store. You'll usually find some lockboxes and other spots to yoink cash from, so scoop it all up, then look for a VCR player near some monitors. It'll look different for every store, but interact with this VCR to scrub footage of your robbery .
As soon as you leave, someone will almost certainly call the cops, so hop into your stashed car, speed away before the cops arrive, and you're good to go. All you have to do is ditch your car, change your clothes, and remove your facial accessories, then you can rob someone in the same area shortly afterwards, allowing you to quite easily chain robberies together.
Although you won't get nearly as much cash as sticking up stores, you'll also unlock the ability to mug civilians after completing Girls Trip. To mug someone, find a civilian a little away from a main road to avoid detection, then aim your pistol at your target and use the social interactions to demand their cash. They'll throw it to you, and boom, you're golden.
Be sure to get out of dodge as quickly as possible so the cops don't catch you in the act (or the civilians you mugged don't call for them). Other than that, this is a pretty low-risk way to make money, albeit low reward.
After the Girls Trip mission, you'll unlock the Moses mission , where you'll meet the titular car mechanic who requests that you boost cars for him. After a quick tutorial, he'll tell you that he'll take any untracked car you find and reward you with cash straight to your bank account.

articles.t: Quatre jours après sa sortie, GTA 6 répare enfin ses averses et ses appels manquants
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 reçoit son premier patch le 23 novembre : crashs, météo figée et sauvegardes sont corrigés. Le téléchargement atteint 1,6 Go sur Xbox Series X|S.
articles.txt:
Le ciel restait désespérément sec et certains appels indispensables à l’histoire n’arrivaient jamais. Quatre jours après son lancement record, le dernier Rockstar reçoit une mise à jour destinée notamment à débloquer ces situations.
Le déploiement a commencé le 23 novembre , avec un téléchargement de 603,8 Mo sur PS5 et de 1,6 Go sur Xbox Series X|S . Cette première mise à jour après la sortie porte le numéro 01.002.002 sur PlayStation et 1.0.2.2 sur Xbox .
Dans les notes publiées sur son site d’assistance, Rockstar indique avoir corrigé plusieurs plantages ainsi que des sauvegardes automatiques qui ne fonctionnaient pas correctement. Le studio mentionne également diverses améliorations générales.
Le correctif s’attaque aussi à une anomalie particulièrement visible : les conditions météorologiques pouvaient rester bloquées pendant de longues périodes. Sur X et Reddit, de nombreux joueurs s’étonnaient ainsi de ne pas voir tomber la pluie. Il s’agissait bien d’un bug, désormais corrigé d’après Rockstar.
Plus gênants pour la progression, certains appels téléphoniques ne se déclenchaient pas, laissant les joueurs dans l’impossibilité de poursuivre l’histoire. Le studio annonce avoir résolu ce problème, ainsi que celui qui empêchait de faire disparaître l’indice de recherche. Des corrections concernent également la salle de sport et les clôtures, sans davantage de précisions dans les éléments rapportés.
Une absence se remarque toutefois dans les notes : la faille permettant de récupérer de l’argent dans la grange rouge située au nord-est de Hamlet n’y figure pas. Des joueurs rapportent qu’elle fonctionne encore après l’installation de cette mise à jour.
Rockstar ne mentionne aucun changement de performances pour cette version. Les consoles restent donc à 30 FPS : ce premier correctif vise les dysfonctionnements du jeu, sans modification annoncée de la fluidité.

Pendant une fenêtre très limitée, certains spectateurs de Twitch reçoivent carrément une copie complète de GTA 6 en cadeau via une campagne officielle de Drops . Oui, le jeu que tout le monde attend peut tomber gratuitement dans votre boîte Twitch.
Derrière cette opération se cache l’événement GTAVI Launch Celebration , lancé pour accompagner la sortie du jeu dans la catégorie GTA VI de Twitch. En plus de simples badges et emotes, la plateforme distribue chaque jour, de façon aléatoire, des codes GTA 6 Ultimate Edition à quelques chanceux. Voici comment fonctionne l’offre et ce qu’il faut faire pour ne pas passer à côté.
La campagne GTAVI Launch Celebration est active sur Twitch entre le 19 novembre et le 30 novembre 2026, ce qui correspond en France à une fin au 1er décembre à 8 h 59. Mais l’intérêt réel, ce sont les codes cachés pour GTA 6 Ultimate Edition . Sur Reddit, l’utilisateur « Eletronic_Match_223 » raconte avoir reçu sans prévenir un code dans sa messagerie Twitch pour la version Ultimate. Twitch résume l’opération en expliquant : « Wir werden als Überraschung GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Codes täglich als Dankeschön droppen ». En clair, des codes sont lâchés chaque jour, de manière surprise, parmi les spectateurs qualifiés. Regarder 1 h pendant plusieurs jours permet d’obtenir les badges, mais ne garantit jamais le jeu : la distribution reste une loterie.
Concrètement, connectez-vous à votre compte Twitch, vérifiez que les Drops sont activés puis allez dans la catégorie GTA VI . Choisissez un stream qui affiche « Drops activés », laissez tourner le live au moins une heure par jour pour récupérer les goodies cosmétiques et, surtout, revenez régulièrement. Les codes de jeu n’arrivent pas par message privé d’un streamer, mais via la cloche de notifications et l’onglet « Drops et récompenses ». Si vous êtes tiré au sort, vous verrez une ligne dédiée « GTA VI Ultimate Edition – game code » avec un bouton pour réclamer la clé, puis choisir votre plateforme PS5 ou Xbox Series X|S . Pensez à garder le site ou l’appli ouverts en étant connecté chaque jour : multiplier les sessions de visionnage augmente vos occasions d’être dans le bon pool au bon moment, même si Twitch ne donne aucune méthode magique pour forcer l’obtention d’un code.
Les Drops de codes sont actifs jusqu’au 30 novembre 2026 côté américain, soit jusqu’au 1er décembre à 8 h 59 en France, mais vous avez un peu plus de marge pour l’activation : Twitch fixe la limite de réclamation au 7 décembre 2026 à 23 h 59 PST, ce qui correspond au 8 décembre à 8 h 59 chez nous. Passé ce délai, le code expire. Les clés concernent uniquement GTA 6 Ultimate Edition , une version premium vendue autour de 99,99 dollars, soit environ 99,99 €, sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S , avec bonus in game et avantages supplémentaires. Attention aux restrictions régionales : votre compte PSN ou Xbox doit être compatible avec la région du code, et l’opération se fait exclusivement via le site et l’application officiels Twitch, sans paiement ni formulaires externes. Méfiez-vous donc des « concours GTA 6 gratuits » qui vous contactent par DM ou redirigent vers des sites douteux, ils n’ont rien à voir avec cette campagne officielle. Cyberleek claims the newly released file could support efforts to bring GTA 6 to PC.
However, Rockstar Games has not verified the authenticity or completeness of the alleged Xbox build. These cryptographic values can help identify files, but they do not independently establish whether the alleged build is authentic.
Modder OptiJuegos has discussed the technical possibility of using an Xbox build to support a PC port. The explanation centers on similarities between the Xbox development environment and Windows architecture. According to OptiJuegos, Xbox builds use Microsoft's Game Development Kit (GDK) and share much of Windows' underlying architecture. These similarities could reduce some of the work involved in adapting the game for PC.
Before the executable appeared, reports also indicated that an Xbox Series X emulator had identified 103 of the 104 files associated with the alleged build. The executable was reportedly the only missing component at that stage. It remains unclear whether the emulator project has updated its findings following the executable's release.
The extent to which the leaked files can support PC porting or emulator development has not yet been established. Leaked game builds also carry potential cybersecurity and legal risks. The authenticity of Cyberleek's files and their relationship to the actual GTA 6 Xbox release remain unconfirmed by Rockstar Games.

articles.txt:
Une lourde peine. Un jeune pirate, qui avait fait fuiter des vidéos de GTA VI sur Internet, plus d'un an avant les premières images officielles, a été condamné à sept ans de prison, lundi 23 novembre, à la Woolwich Crown Court de Londres. Adolescent au moment des faits, Arion Kurtaj, aujourd'hui âgé de 21 ans, faisait partie du groupe de pirates informatiques Lapsus$, a avancé l'accusation.
L'intéressé est cependant ressorti libre du tribunal, en raison du temps déjà passé en détention. Cette décision a été prise "en pesant, d'une part, la gravité de ce que vous avez fait et, d'autre part, votre jeune âge" , explique le juge Mark Turner. Il a ajouté avoir aussi tenu compte de ses antécédents médicaux, notamment son autisme - l'individu ayant passé deux ans dans un hôpital sécurisé depuis son arrestation. "Vous êtes de toute évidence un jeune homme très talentueux. Ne gâchez pas ces talents en passant le reste de votre vie à entrer et sortir de prison" , appelle le magistrat.
"Ce qui se passe dans GTA VI reste dans GTA VI" : les polices appellent les joueurs à ne pas commettre de crimes dans la vraie vie
En septembre 2022, Arion Kurtaj est parvenu à pirater le studio Rockstar Games avec un téléphone portable, la télévision de l'hôtel connectée au wifi et un "Fire stick", une clé TV commercialisée par Amazon permettant de se connecter à différents services, raconte à l'AFP la police de la City de Londres, qui a mené l'enquête. Il a ensuite volé 90 vidéos du très attendu GTA VI, avant de les diffuser en ligne sous le pseudonyme "TeaPotUberHacker". Il avait aussi menacé de divulguer le code source du jeu, a indiqué le parquet. Selon le studio, le préjudice s'élève à plus de 1,5 million de dollars, sans prendre en compte les conséquences commerciales de cette cyberattaque. Le pirate a également mené des attaques contre la banque en ligne Revolut, la plateforme Uber et l'opérateur britannique BT/EE. Il a plaidé coupable de tous ces faits.
Grand Theft Auto VI, sixième volet de la franchise éponyme, est sorti jeudi 19 novembre, 13 ans après le précédent. Le jeu a pulvérisé les records de vente avec 3,79 milliards de dollars générés en 24 heures, assure Rockstar Games.

Sony détaille un peu plus la rétrocompatibilité sur sa PlayStation 5. Il sera possible de jouer à la grande majorité des jeux PlayStation 4 sur la PS5, mais tous ne seront pas compatibles.
Arion Kurtaj, le hacker responsable de la fuite de près d’une heure de séquences de développement de GTA 6 en 2022, a été libéré ce lundi 23 novembre en faisant l’objet d’une libération conditionnelle. Âgé de 21 ans, il a été condamné à sept ans de prison par le tribunal de Woolwich au Royaume-Uni, mais a pu sortir immédiatement après avoir déjà passé plusieurs années en détention et dans un établissement psychiatrique sécurisé.
Le jeune homme, membre du groupe de hackers Lapsus$, avait plaidé coupable le 16 novembre d’une série de cyberattaques visant plusieurs grandes entreprises, dont Rockstar Games, Uber, Revolut et l’opérateur BT/EE. Les faits remontent à ses 16 et 17 ans. Au total, il a reconnu six infractions, parmi lesquelles des accès informatiques non autorisés, une fraude et la possession d’un téléphone portable en prison. Sept autres accusations ont été conservées au dossier sans faire l’objet d’une condamnation.
L’intrusion la plus médiatisée remonte à septembre 2022 . Alors qu’il se trouvait dans un hôtel de Bicester en Angleterre, où il avait été placé sous protection policière après de précédentes affaires de piratage, Arion Kurtaj a réussi à pénétrer dans les systèmes internes de Rockstar Games. Son ordinateur ayant été confisqué, il a utilisé une clé Amazon Fire TV connectée au téléviseur de sa chambre, accompagnée d’un clavier et d’une souris Bluetooth, pour accéder au réseau informatique de l’établissement et mener son attaque.
Il a récupéré 90 vidéos montrant près de 60 minutes de séquences de développement de GTA 6 , encore loin de sa version finale. Après avoir tenté d’extorquer Rockstar Games en menaçant de publier le code source du jeu, il a diffusé les images sur des forums sous le pseudonyme TeaPotUberHacker. Cette fuite avait notamment révélé l’existence de Lucia, première protagoniste féminine de la série dans un rôle principal jouable. Rockstar Games avait estimé le coût de remise en état de ses systèmes à 5 millions de dollars, sans compter les milliers d’heures de travail mobilisées par ses équipes
L’affaire avait connu un premier dénouement judiciaire en décembre 2023. Après une expertise médicale, Arion Kurtaj avait été déclaré inapte à comparaître devant un tribunal en raison de son état de santé et de son autisme. Un juge avait alors ordonné son placement dans un établissement psychiatrique sécurisé pour une durée indéterminée avec des restrictions. Un jury avait néanmoins établi qu’il avait bien commis les piratages qui lui étaient reprochés.
En janvier 2026, une nouvelle évaluation a permis la levée de cette mesure et son transfert dans une prison classique, ouvrant la voie à un procès pénal. Après son plaidoyer de culpabilité du 16 novembre, la justice a prononcé une peine de sept ans, réduite de deux années pour tenir compte du temps passé sous hospitalisation sécurisée. Il a donc pu quitter sa détention dès le prononcé du jugement, sous le régime d’une libération conditionnelle.
Sa sortie s’accompagne de restrictions supplémentaires. Selon la BBC , une ordonnance de prévention des crimes graves (SCPO) lui interdit notamment d’utiliser Telegram et Discord pendant cinq ans. Le juge Justice Turner lui a adressé un avertissement lors de l’audience : « Vous êtes manifestement un jeune homme très talentueux. Ne laissez pas cela se reproduire ». La police de la Cité de Londres indique également vouloir obtenir une telle ordonnance, ce qui laisse une incertitude sur la formalisation définitive de ces restrictions.

Getting GTA 6 running on PC without waiting for Rockstar has become the latest goal for the modding community. Cyberleek has fulfilled its threat by releasing the missing 57MB main executable file (.exe) for the leaked Xbox development build . This follows its previous release of a massive 209GB torrent containing RAGE engine assets and Xbox build files.
Cyberleek described the release as an “early Christmas gift” and a protest against digital subscription models and expensive editions, including $20 “Ultimate Editions”. The group had previously linked the release to its cryptocurrency reaching a $15 million market value, but eventually made the file available on November 23 as promised.
The Xbox build was chosen because modern Xbox games use technology closely related to Windows, making it easier to bring them to PC. Projects such as Leonida are now working to recompile the game so it can run natively on PC.
Developers are already using AI coding tools such as Anthropic’s Claude to read the files and understand the game’s code. However, getting it to run remains a challenge. An update shared on the project’s Discord server stated : “THE GAME ALMOST BOOTS. BLACK SCREEN, AUDIO CUTS OFF.”
Although the game is getting closer to running, there is still a lot of work left. The project team says it could take at least another week of work before a playable PC version is ready.
Meanwhile, Cyberleek’s release has put Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar Games’ parent company, under further pressure. The company has reportedly been trying to remove the leaked files from the internet through takedowns and legal requests.
If the modding community manages to release a working PC version, Rockstar and its parent company could take further action.
For now, PC players will have to wait for Rockstar’s official release. While the modders are getting closer to making the leaked build run on PC, there’s still a lot of work ahead before anyone can actually play it. And if you come across a download claiming to offer a working PC version of GTA 6 , be careful, as these files are often fake and may contain viruses.
As more information becomes available, we’ll make sure to let you guys know here at eTeknix.
In other news, GTA 6 has reportedly reached 20 million pre-orders before launch , potentially generating over $1.6 billion in revenue. In addition, the game has broken Twitch’s all-time gaming viewership record , reaching 3.3 million concurrent viewers just hours after launch.

GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek has reportedly released the executable file for the leaked Xbox build of the game, prompting concern that an unofficial PC port could follow.
The leak comes via the same group that shared leaked footage and threatened to release additional videos unless Rockstar changed its all-digital launch strategy a week before Rockstar released its extended gameplay teaser on Netflix . The group then threatened to release a full build of the game, including its full story mode and end credits.
Now, as reported by IGN , Cyberleek has released the .exe for the incomplete Xbox build, with some predicting that AI-assisted recompilation of the build could get GTA 6 running on PC within days.
The file was released alongside a new statement in which Cyberleek claimed their actions were about "fighting anti-consumerism in the games industry."
They also referenced Take-Two's efforts to stop the leaks and identify whoever is behind them, saying: "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving."
Cyberleek also pushed back on claims that the leaks are little more than a crypto scheme, insisting the crypto was used to raise money for a secret project unrelated to the game. "There is no other way to move funds without names," they said, "and this work requires no names."
According to IGN, the leaked Xbox build runs counter to the idea that Cyberleek only had access to an early build.
Take-Two previously issued subpoenas to companies including Discord as part of its search for those responsible for the leaks. It remains unclear how this build got out of Rockstar.

articles.txt:
Sony détaille un peu plus la rétrocompatibilité sur sa PlayStation 5. Il sera possible de jouer à la grande majorité des jeux PlayStation 4 sur la PS5, mais tous ne seront pas compatibles.
Après avoir partagé l’intégralité de la version Xbox de Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ) , le groupe de hackers Cyberleek propose aujourd’hui l’ultime fichier : le fichier exécutable. Cela va permettre au projet Leonida de porter le jeu de manière officieuse sur PC.
Le fichier .exe est disponible. Toujours gratuit. Un cadeau de Noël avant l’heure de la part de CL. Le flambeau est désormais transmis aux projets open source de recompilation et d’émulation. Avant de faire confiance à un fichier, vérifiez-le. Voici les seuls et uniques hachages authentiques.
ZIP SHA-256 : 7545a2f7fb4b399cf8850987f087ed9a4d8499ddb6d6c2d642fd60c27f569730
EXE SHA-256 : e95020b2fa4a721db3df59fdecf75621730ac559d8835252f6c3b658d5a08993
Chaque version a toujours été gratuite et le restera. Si ce projet vous tient à cœur, soutenez-le. Chaque don est un vote en faveur de la poursuite de cette initiative. CL suit la direction indiquée par les votes. La cryptomonnaie n’est ici qu’un outil : il n’existe aucun autre moyen de transférer des fonds de manière anonyme. Vous trouverez l’histoire complète dans le fichier README.txt contenu dans l’archive ZIP. Pas de propriété du jeu, pas de paix.
Comme dit précédemment, il s’agit ici de la version Xbox et non de la version PC. Il ne suffit pas de télécharger le jeu et de lancer le fichier .exe pour jouer à GTA 6 sur PC. Tout un travail d’adaptation doit avoir lieu. Et il se trouve que c’est déjà en cours.
Le projet Leonida sur GitHub a pour but de recompiler la version Xbox de GTA 6 pour la faire tourner sur PC sans passer par un émulateur. Les développeurs du projet ne se cachent pas d’utiliser Claude, l’intelligence artificielle d’Anthropic, pour arriver au but qu’ils désirent. Ils ont déjà progressé comme ils le dévoilent sur leur Discord puisqu’ils ont été en mesure de lancer le jeu… mais tombent sur un écran noir. Ce n’est que le début, il reste encore énormément de travail. Mais il y a déjà eu beaucoup de progrès en coulisses ces derniers jours.
Il se trouve que les Xbox Series X/S et les PC utilisent la même architecture, à savoir des processeurs x86-64. Cela va donc faciliter la tâche. Malgré tout, le jeu de Rockstar Games se repose sur des éléments spécifiques aux consoles de Microsoft et les auteurs du projet Leonida vont donc devoir réussir à les adapter sur PC avec l’aide de Claude.
Pour rappel, Rockstar Games a annoncé que Grand Theft Auto VI a représenté 3,79 milliards de dollars de ventes lors de sa première journée. Il y a eu 32,5 millions de précommandes.

GTA 6 : toutes les fins possibles et comment les débloquer
articles.chapeau: Jason et Lucia peuvent-ils finir ensemble, mourir tragiquement ou prendre des chemins séparés ? Voici toutes les fins recensées jusqu'à présent et comment y arriver.
articles.txt:
Jason et Lucia peuvent-ils finir ensemble, mourir tragiquement ou prendre des chemins séparés ? Voici toutes les fins recensées jusqu’à présent et comment y arriver.
Comme des millions de joueurs à travers le monde, vous avez peut-être passé votre weekend sur GTA 6 . S’il faut compter quelque 50 à 60 heures pour terminer l’histoire principale, nombreux sont les joueurs qui ont pu arriver à la conclusion de l’aventure depuis la disponibilité du titre jeudi dernier.
Comme dans les précédents épisodes de la saga, Rockstar Games ne propose pas une conclusion unique à son histoire. Dans GTA 6 , les décisions prises pendant la campagne peuvent changer le destin de Jason et Lucia. Et il ne suffit pas de choisir une option au dernier moment pour obtenir la meilleure conclusion, certains paramètres accumulés tout au long de l’aventure entrent également en jeu.
Même s’il est encore un peu tôt pour être certain du nombre de fins, ce premier guide devrait pouvoir vous aiguiller un minimum. Les articles et retours publiés depuis la sortie du jeu ne s’accordent pas encore tous sur le nombre exact de conclusions. Plusieurs recensent cinq fins principales, tandis que d’autres en distinguent sept en comptabilisant certaines variantes. Voici ce que l’on sait pour le moment, et surtout comment débloquer chacune d’entre elles.
La première bifurcation intervient pendant la mission “Protective Custody”, après l’évasion de Jason. Face à l’agent Méndez, le joueur peut choisir de lui tirer dessus immédiatement ou d’attendre environ une minute pour voir apparaître une nouvelle option : accepter son offre. En choisissant cette seconde possibilité, Jason et Lucia concluent un accord avec lui, mais leur confiance sera rapidement trahie. Après une opération dans un gratte-ciel, Méndez les fait arrêter et les emmène dans les marais de Leonida. Le générique révèle finalement leurs deux crânes près d’un alligator. C’est l’une des conclusions les plus sombres du jeu.
Une autre possibilité apparaît si le joueur accepte initialement l’accord de Méndez, mais tente ensuite de s’échapper lors de l’affrontement dans la tour. Deux variantes sont alors possibles : Lucia peut choisir de défendre Jason, entraînant leur mort à tous les deux dans une fusillade, ou rester à terre lorsque Jason se sacrifie pour la protéger. Dans ce dernier cas, Lucia survit et peut retrouver son fils, mais se retrouve dans une situation financière précaire et reprend ses activités criminelles. Retour à la case départ.
Si vous refusez l’accord de Méndez, vous accédez à la mission finale classique, “The End of the Road”. Sur un pont encerclé par la police, deux choix s’offrent alors à vous. Avec “No Surrender”, Jason et Lucia décident de foncer sur les forces de l’ordre et meurent tous les deux dans une ultime fusillade. Avec “Swim For It”, ils tentent au contraire de s’échapper par l’eau, mais le résultat dépend de votre progression.
Si leur relation est suffisamment développée et que leur profil criminel reste raisonnable, Jason et Lucia peuvent sortir de leur véhicule sans arme. Jason finit toutefois par se laisser arrêter pour permettre à Lucia de s’enfuir. Il retrouve ensuite son fils au parloir de la prison. C’est une fin douce-amère, mais elle peut devenir beaucoup plus heureuse si le couple a également économisé 2 millions de dollars sur son compte familial BuckMe. Deux ans plus tard, Lucia utilise cet argent pour obtenir la libération de Jason. La famille est enfin réunie.
Pour obtenir cette meilleure conclusion, il faut donc atteindre le niveau maximal de relation “Hot Together”, maintenir des profils criminels suffisamment propres et accumuler 2 millions de dollars sur l’épargne familiale. Attention, car seul l’argent déposé sur BuckMe compte, pas celui conservé en poche. Il est également conseillé de faire une sauvegarde manuelle avant de lancer le dénouement.
Ce décompte reste à prendre avec précaution car il n’est absolument pas final. Rockstar n’a pas officiellement communiqué le nombre de conclusions et au vu de la précision de certains paramètres, il n’est clairement pas impossible que d’autres variantes soient trouvées dans les prochains jours. Dans tous les cas, il existe pour le moment peu de fins heureuses pour Jason et Lucia. La bonne nouvelle est aussi qu’il est possible de relancer le final après les crédits pour découvrir d’autres issues sans recommencer toute l’aventure.

articles.chapeau: Cyberleek publie l'exécutable Xbox de GTA 6. Project Leonida peut désormais avancer vers une recompilation PC, mais le jeu reste encore injouable.
articles.txt:
Après avoir diffusé une imposante archive de fichiers Xbox de GTA VI sans fournir le moyen de lancer le jeu, Cyberleek a finalement publié l’exécutable manquant ce 23 novembre. Une étape importante pour les développeurs amateurs qui tentent de faire fonctionner le titre de Rockstar sur PC grâce à la recompilation native ; mais malgré les premiers progrès annoncés, une version jouable reste encore à construire.
Pour rappel, Cyberleek avait mis en circulation le 19 novembre une archive d’environ 209 Go, présentée comme une version Xbox Series X|S du jeu, identifiée sous le numéro 1.0.2.1 et datée de novembre 2026. Elle contenait notamment des ressources graphiques, des textures, des modèles et des fichiers audio, mais pas l’exécutable principal indispensable au démarrage. Le leaker avait promis de publier ce dernier le 23 novembre, tout en conditionnant une éventuelle diffusion anticipée à la capitalisation de sa cryptomonnaie.
Cette fois, le fichier a bien été mis en ligne, accompagné de clés de contrôle SHA-256 censées permettre d’en vérifier l’intégrité ; son authenticité n’a toutefois pas encore été confirmée de manière indépendante. Cyberleek précise par ailleurs qu’il ne faut pas tenter de l’exécuter directement sous Windows : il est destiné aux équipes travaillant sur des outils de recompilation et d’émulation, ce qui nécessitera encore un peu de travail supplémentaires, mais rien d’insurmontable mais les moddeurs.
Parmi les initiatives concernées, Project Leonida cherche à transformer la version Xbox en une version PC native. La recompilation statique consiste à adapter le code du jeu et les composants propres à l’environnement Xbox pour qu’ils puissent fonctionner sous Windows. Le projet avait déjà préparé une partie importante du travail, notamment la traduction des shaders graphiques vers Vulkan.
La publication de l’exécutable a rapidement permis de progresser : quelques heures après sa diffusion, les développeurs de Leonida indiquaient que le jeu approchait du démarrage, malgré un écran noir et des coupures audio. Ce résultat reste très éloigné d’une version pleinement fonctionnelle, mais marque un premier pas concret.
Cyberleek avait assuré que la communauté pourrait faire tourner le jeu à plus de 30 images par seconde en une semaine, au grand dam de la philosophie de Rockstar . Cette prédiction reste à prendre avec prudence : démarrer le jeu ne signifie pas pouvoir y jouer dans de bonnes conditions. Rockstar, de son côté, n’a toujours pas annoncé de date pour une éventuelle version PC officielle.

articles.t: GTA 6 Xbox Executable Leaks Online as “Early Christmas Gift” from Cyberleek
articles.chapeau: Just days after release, a playable build leaks.
articles.txt:
By Kyle Gratton Published Nov 23, 2026, 1:38 PM EST Kyle Gratton is an writer and editor based out of Kansas City. He received a bachelor's degree, dual majoring in English and History with a minor in Film and Media Studies, and has been a senior writer and gaming critic for Screen Rant since 2021 and CBR since 2026, in addition to a role in editorial. A terminal Midwesterner who graduated from the University of Kansas, Kyle also has knowledge and interest in literature, film, film adaptions of literature, and history. Find Kyle on Letterboxd: KyleG5 Sign in to your CBR account The executable file for Grand Theft Auto 6 's Xbox version has been released by notorious hacker(s) Cyberleek, meaning it may only be a matter of time before a PC recompilation is built. Rockstar Games' latest open-world crime odyssey has seen unprecedented popularity, becoming the highest-grossing entertainment product of all time, despite a review bombing campaign by disgruntled manosphere types. GTA 6 has, notably, only released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, with a potential PC port yet to be confirmed by Rockstar.
Development of Grand Theft Auto 6 was plagued for years by leaks. A massive haul of mid-development GTA 6 gameplay footage leaked in 2022, an unprecedented breach that would only be topped by a leaker (or leakers) known as Cyberleek posting release-build footage online just months before the game's launch. Cyberleek has now made good on a promise to release the build they acquired for their previous leaks.
Jason and Lucia dancing together in GTA 6 Image via Rockstar Games The executable (.exe) file for GTA 6 's Xbox version 1.0.2.1 is now available on Cyberleek's website. This is a release version of GTA 6 , only playable on an Xbox Series X or Series S, and not an available PC version. It is available as a torrent for free, but Cyberleek is still asking for donations to fund a still-mysterious "project." They are alternatively still running their own cryptocurrency as a part of their fundraising.
CBR will not link directly to Cyberleek's website or the .exe file. Readers are urged to be extremely cautious of malware should they attempt to seek it out.
The readme.txt that accompanies the .exe has been copied to Pastebin , providing an overview of Cyberleek's stated motives, their project, which "stays under wraps for now," and various information about donating or trading the Cyberleek token. "Take the Xbox build and the main executable as an early Christmas gift," the readme file says, "from CYBERLEEK to every gamer."
Cyberleek's generous tone follows from the consumerist statements that begin the readme file. The hacker(s) reiterate their support of players, noting their leaks never contained story content because they didn't want to spoil the game that "Millions waited years for." This latest creed stresses that the leaks are targeted at corporations, and are not anti- GTA 6 : "The enemy is the tactic, not the game: subscriptions bolted onto single-player games, 20 dollar 'ultimate editions' that unlock what already sits in the game files, licenses sold as purchases. All of it needs to be eliminated."
GTA 6 key art featuring Radio La Ola Image via Rockstar Games This leak ultimately does little more than fast-track an unofficial PC port of GTA 6 . With the full Xbox build and the .exe file, recompilation efforts should, theoretically, have few barriers left. Vibe-coded attempts are almost certainly going to appear in the next few days, but it remains to be seen how well these bootleg versions run. Cyberleek seems confident that the leaked Xbox build will be emulated within a week's time.
If this version fails to get a working PC port of GTA 6 , Cyberleek will turn its attention to leaking the PS5 version. Cyberleek has so far been able to evade capture, ignoring "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing." Previous leaks were clearly not taken lightly, but a full build leaking is likely to spur Rockstar's efforts. Although piracy is broadly undertaken by only a small fraction of PC players, the threat of a recompilation could seriously jeopardize Rockstar's plans to bring Grand Theft Auto 6 to PC at a future date.
